why.narrowestControlPx: The narrowest control is the row of three RSVP status chips in src/app/(public)/r/[token]/rsvp-form.tsx. They share a row from 20rem of form width: (320 - 2 * 8 gap) / 3 - 2 * 12 padding - 2 border = 75px at 16px text, which is 66px at 14px.
why.fullRowButtonPx: A whitespace-nowrap Button on a full row at a 320px screen: 320 - 2 * 16 gutter - 2 * 12 padding - 2 border.
why.keyPattern: Key names of labels the code scan can't place, because they are defined in one file and shown in another. Used only for those keys.
